visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man's hands are shown in a close-up, pouring KitKat Cereal from a bright red branded box into a glass bowl containing milk and black boba pearls. The background is a clean, white indoor surface under bright, even lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a man pouring the cereal into a plastic container of cold noodles with shredded cucumbers and carrots. He uses chopsticks to mix the food rapidly, with visual speed lines and sparkling graphic effects overlaying the action to emphasize intensity. (3) The man is seated on a grey sofa in a living room, holding the noodle container. He takes a large bite, exhibiting an exaggeratedly surprised and then joyful facial expression. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his chopsticks. (4) The camera focuses on a bowl where milk tea and boba are poured, followed by a generous serving of KitKat cereal. The man is then shown eating a spoonful, closing his eyes and nodding with a satisfied smile, giving a thumbs-up to the camera. (5) The man stands in front of a grey background, holding two boxes of the cereal. He opens a large red box on a table, revealing a promotional 'Monopoly' themed gift set containing a branded bowl, spoon, and red dice. He points at the items and gives another thumbs-up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong, driving beat. A male voice speaks enthusiastically, accompanied by the distinct, percussive sound of dry cereal hitting a bowl and a soft liquid splash. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as the narration accelerates, matching the rapid visual mixing. The speaker's pitch rises during the description of the 'creative' noodle recipe. (3) Sounds of loud, intentional slurping and a very crisp, resonant crunching sound follow, emphasizing the food's texture. The narrator maintains a high-energy, friendly tone with clear articulation and minimal pauses. (4) A smooth pouring sound of milk tea is heard, followed by a 'ding' SFX as the man tastes the food. His vocalization shifts to a low-arousal, satisfied 'Mmm' sound. (5) The BGM continues as a cardboard rustling and clicking sound signals the opening of a gift box. The speaker's volume increases for a high-arousal call to action, concluding the track with a final energetic phrase and a quick fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experiment 1 (Noodles) -> Experiment 2 (Boba) -> CTA -> Product Reveal.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Nestlé KitKat Cereal by demonstrating unconventional and 'creative' ways to consume it beyond traditional milk, aimed at engaging a young audience through viral-style food experimentation and a giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the cereal box, mention of the official IG account, and unboxing of a branded gift set.
